title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child with autism improve participation in family gatherings?
metaTitle: Enhancing Participation in Family Gatherings with Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms helps children with autism participate more effectively in family gatherings.
html: Of course, participation in family gatherings is an important part of social connection. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our occupational therapists introduce strategies such as social stories, role-playing, visual schedules, and planned sensory breaks to make these social situations manageable and predictable for your child. This can enhance their comfort, participation, and enjoyment during these gatherings.
